[P2] Release coordinator state after the final checkpoint drain

The final drain still calls `processOperations()` after this unregister. If it delivers a `CHAINED_INVOKE` START whose result the completed handler did not await, `handleInvokeUpdate()` registers a new handoff for the already-unregistered caller. A non-durable target that never resolves leaves that handoff permanently in `invokes`, so subsequent runners sharing the clock wait in real time despite `skipTime`. Move coordinator cleanup after the final poll/drain updates are processed, or prevent handoff registration for settled callers. Add a regression where the invoke START arrives through the final drain before an unrelated long-wait execution.
